title: Chimeric Antigen Receptors T Cells for Refractory/Recurrent Lupus Nephritis in Children
off: An Exploratory Clinical Study of the Safety and Efficacy of CAR-T in Children With Refractory/Recurrent Lupus Nephritis Disease
sponsor: Guangzhou Women and Children's Medical Center
summary: The goal of this prospective, open, single-arm clinical trial was to evaluate the safety and potential efficacy of CAR T cell therapy in children with refractory/recurrent lupus nephritis. The persistence and cell phenotype of CAR-T cells in vivo and CAR-T treatment-related inflammatory factors were evaluated after treatment. To explore new therapeutic methods, in order to reduce the side effects of traditional therapeutic drugs, increase curative effect, and finally make patients obtain long-term survival and improve survival quality.

arms.d: Children who met the inclusion criteria were given transfusions of CAR-T cells

primary.m: Number of participants with CAR-T cells treatment-related adverse events(AE)
